text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Yay~! It's been so long since we went on a 
trip! 
I never imagined we'd get to go to an 
amusement park during training!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes, today is a special menu. 
Our objective is to have as much fun as 
possible and deepen our bonds as 
teammates.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Special order acknowledged. However, I 
believe that the act of "enjoying the 
amusement park" falls under the category 
of "play" rather than practice.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is both a yes and a no. 
This, too, is a very fine and 
indispensable menu on our road to victory.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
By taking care of minds fatigued from 
unfamiliar practice and deepening our 
teamwork, 
we can reach the state required to proceed 
to the next step I have prepared.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, that sounds pretty deep! Now I'm 
super curious about what it is, though.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
You'll find that out as a treat at the end 
of the day. 
Until then, please refresh yourselves to 
your heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Now then, which coaster shall we conquer 
first?! 
The giant loop? The vertical drop? Or 
perhaps the dizzying twister coaster?!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
They're all super fast and scary?! 
Bakushin O-san, p-please go easy on me...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nonsense! When it comes to rides and 
running alike, faster is always better! 
Come along now! Everyone, follow your 
Class Rep!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text: Wah-wah-wah, wait for meee~!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Proposal: Information regarding 
"limited-time sweets" has been acquired 
from Rice-san. 
I have received an order requesting 
feedback on them.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Is that so? Then count me in♪ 
The weather's lovely, and having sweets 
with everyone is the best~♪

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: Fufu... Everyone is in good spirits.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That was so much fun~! We rode so many 
coasters, 
even if my head is spinning now!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Tannhauser-san, you were wonderful! To 
think you could keep up with my Great 
Bakushin Consecutive Coaster Festival 
right to the very end!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, you two have gotten so close. But 
while waiting, I had lots of fun chatting 
with Ikuno-chan and Bourbon-chan too♪

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Recommended Sweets" data installation 
complete. 
My sincere gratitude to Laurel-san for the 
valuable sweets intelligence.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I'm glad you enjoyed it! 
Let's invite the others and hang out like 
this again sometime♪

text_block_list.name: Taiyaki Shop Owner
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Omachi-chan and company! I heard 
you're entering the Demon Dodgeball 
tournament! 
I look forward to it every year, so show 
me a match with great teamwork, will ya?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ah, mister from before~! Yes, we'll do our 
absolute best to win and show you how cool 
we can be!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
We shall achieve a glorious victory and 
present a magnificent live performance for 
you! 
I promise you that!

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
...Ehehe, it really is all thanks to 
Ikuno, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
That mister was looking forward to the 
Demon Dodgeball match, but without Ikuno, 
we wouldn't have even understood the 
rules.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Plus, I'm happy we'll be able to 
show him a "match with great teamwork." I 
feel like we've gotten so close over the 
course of today!

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That would be because our mutual 
understanding has increased through 
unstructured interaction. 
That was precisely the purpose of today's 
"special menu."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Mutual understanding... In that case, may 
I ask a question? 
—Regarding Ikuno-san's "motivation."

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: My motivation?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Affirmative. Why does Ikuno-san "devote" 
herself so deeply to the team? 
I am unable to calculate your level of 
desire to win at Demon Dodgeball.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Come to think of it, I've just been 
taking all your help for granted, but did 
you even want to play Demon Dodgeball for 
the Fan Appreciation Festival in the first 
place, Ikuno?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Both of you... Fufu, please put your minds 
at ease.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Of course, I want to compete in Demon 
Dodgeball as well. 
And I have a clear reason for aiming for 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
Ikuno's reason... for aiming for 
victory...?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Yes. There is a sight that I wish to see. 
In order to behold it, I want to win this 
Fan Appreciation Festival alongside 
everyone.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
...Once upon a time, I had a dependable 
partner—

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It was a sports bicycle that my father 
modified for me so that I could ride it, 
back when an illness prevented me from 
running.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
My partner gave me many gifts. One of 
which was the realization that depending 
on how one manages the frame, its 
performance can change indefinitely.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
If I practiced careful and thorough 
maintenance, 
my partner never failed to reward me with 
speed and stability.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And with that power, it carried me 
endlessly far when I could not run myself. 
As if to teach me that nothing is 
impossible, as long as one does not give 
up.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
And the sights I arrived at with my 
partner—were beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Even I could go anywhere under my own 
power. The confidence my partner gave me 
continues to support my running even now, 
having overcome that illness.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
That is why, when I saw everyone striving 
to take on a brand-new sport without even 
knowing the rules, I wished to put my 
management skills to use.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
When I dedicate myself to the team's 
management and overcome these difficulties 
together with you all, I am certain I will 
see a sight as beautiful as the one I saw 
back then.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —That is what I am looking forward to.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, "victory" is very much a goal 
of my own. 
Assisting you all is only natural.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Empathy with Ikuno-san's "aspiration" 
confirmed. 
...Thank you for sharing your story.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
I think I finally understand the meaning 
behind today's "special menu." 
Because my desire to win as a team has 
grown so much stronger.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
If each of you holds such strong feelings, 
then granting them is my duty as your 
Class Representative!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Yeah. Let's combine our strength and all 
share in that same sight together! 
If we win, we'll surely stand on the most 
wonderful stage of all.

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
Everyone, thank you. 
And finally, could you listen to one more 
thing?

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
It is regarding the next stage we are to 
advance to, which I promised to share once 
today's menu was complete.

text_block_list.name: Matikanetannhauser
text_block_list.text:
"Oh right, I almost forgot! That's what 
you came up with, 
Ikuno, the thing we need to take the 
championship, right?"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Precisely. What we need right now is a 
weapon to elevate our baseline strength 
and illuminate the difficult path toward 
'victory.'"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text:
"Possessing it will instill confidence, 
and honing it will guarantee 'victory.' 
The ultimate weapon we must acquire by all 
means. That is—"

text_block_list.name: Ikuno Dictus
text_block_list.text: —A 'Special Move.'
